nodes.label: Brand Color Contrast Check
nodes.rationale: Switches --on-brand to the ink color on light brand colors so text stays readable whatever logo color a client supplies.

nodes.label: dayRange()
nodes.rationale: A closing time at or before the opening time is pushed forward 24 hours so past-midnight hours compare correctly.

nodes.label: Demo Page Renderer IIFE
nodes.rationale: The whole page is built from config and written to #app, so optional sections disappear when their data is absent and client folders need no HTML edits.

nodes.label: data.js Client Config
nodes.rationale: The single file edited per client: name, logo colors, menu, hours, WhatsApp number and Google Maps location.

nodes.label: demo: true Preview Flag
nodes.rationale: Shows the Weblume preview ribbon until the client pays; then it is set to false and the site moves to the client's repo and domain.

nodes.label: Noindex Demo Pages
nodes.rationale: Client previews stay out of Google search results.

nodes.label: Client Demo Workflow
nodes.rationale: Each prospect gets a folder copied from _template, so a personalized preview only requires editing data.js and adding images.

nodes.label: Instagram DM Fallback (ig.me/m/weblume1)
nodes.rationale: Used only when the chat module has not loaded, so a submitted request still reaches Weblume.

nodes.label: window.WeblumeChat Live Chat Bridge
nodes.rationale: The order form sends the request as the visitor's first chat message, so the conversation continues on the site instead of leaving it.

nodes.label: data-en Attribute Translation Pattern
nodes.rationale: Arabic is the markup default; English lives in data-en and data-en-ph attributes, and the Arabic is cached into data-ar at startup so one page can switch language and direction without a framework. The choice persists in localStorage under weblume-lang.

nodes.label: Background Performance Guard Levels
nodes.rationale: Weak devices step from full (2) to lite (1) to static (0): fewer icons and lower resolution first, then a frozen background. Hardware hints set the start level and measured frame time drives later steps.

nodes.label: Icon Sprite Rasterization
nodes.rationale: The SVG icon is rasterized once and the bitmap is blitted each frame, which is much cheaper than drawing SVG every frame.

nodes.label: brew()
nodes.rationale: Scene 1: grinding, espresso and milk pour frames, ending on the big word with the Loopie cup.

nodes.label: window.CAFE (Loopie)
nodes.rationale: Menu items come from reviews and customer photos, and prices and hours still need the cafe to confirm them.

nodes.label: draw()
nodes.rationale: Draws the nearest loaded frame on canvas, cropped to cover.

nodes.label: drinks()
nodes.rationale: Scene 3 and the live thing: pick a mood, a play on the line from the cafe about differing on the weather, and it leads to a drink on a disc.

nodes.label: frame()
nodes.rationale: Runs every scene and the sideways gallery from one scroll listener.

nodes.label: iris() Scene Transition
nodes.rationale: Each scene closes as a circle opening onto the next scene color.

nodes.label: Arabic and English Switch
nodes.rationale: Language comes from ?lang= in the link, then the saved choice, then Arabic. English text lives in CAFE.en in data.js and merges over the Arabic.

nodes.label: load()
nodes.rationale: Loads frames coarse first, with fewer frames in data saver mode.

nodes.label: loopOpen()
nodes.rationale: One motif direction: the footage starts in a giant circle taken from the Loopie logo loops and opens to the whole screen.

nodes.label: Loopie Cafe Page
nodes.rationale: Built with the design-taste-frontend skill, direction one-motif, seed 867893197. The loop in the logo runs the masks, buttons and transitions. Scroll engine uses no library.

nodes.label: Place Photos
nodes.rationale: Free stock photos of seating, not the real cafe. Asser rejected the Google Maps photos and the map embed.

nodes.label: pour()
nodes.rationale: Closing invite: a muted looping clip grows from a circle to the whole screen.

nodes.label: pump()
nodes.rationale: Loads frames six at a time.

nodes.label: roast()
nodes.rationale: Scene 2: three graded cut-outs of one macro bean photo crossfade with the temperature counter. Temperatures are general coffee facts, not the cafe's.

nodes.label: sequence()
nodes.rationale: Queues coarse frames first so scrubbing works before everything has loaded. Phones get the portrait frame set.
